scope: Generated public test content only, not private meeting audio
unicode: Kazakh Ә Ғ Қ Ң Ө Ұ Ү Һ І, Russian and English

pdf.note: Poppler emitted optional nameToUnicode data-file lookup warnings; both page PNGs rendered and were inspected

docx.renderer: Microsoft Word COM ExportAsFixedFormat, source opened read-only; PDF rasterized by bundled Poppler
docx.fallback_note: Bundled documents render_docx.py lacked soffice.exe; installed Microsoft Word provided the verified conversion fallback

bounded_exports.txt_markdown_json: Streaming iter_segments, one pass, tested with 20000 segments
bounded_exports.limit_behavior: Actionable error recommends TXT or JSON, deletes only the newly created partial file

local_destination: Explicit existing local folder; rejects UNC, URI and mapped network drives via config.local_directory
overwrite_behavior: Exclusive x/xb create; existing files never replaced
clock_basis: RTMS session by default; meeting basis only when explicitly recorded in store metadata
